verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client with an in-app conversational Repository Agent, so managing agent work from a phone is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows it launching, monitoring or tracking cloud-hosted coding agent tasks. The in-app agent works through conversation on local repositories, which is an adjacent feature rather than cloud task management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone
